# Third-party notices — runtime dependencies

Général Midi Boop itself is distributed under the MIT License (see
[`LICENSE`](./LICENSE)). It ships and links the third-party packages listed
below, each under its own licence. This file exists to satisfy the
attribution clause those licences carry (MIT/BSD "the above copyright notice
… shall be included in all copies", Apache-2.0 §4).

Scope: the **runtime** closure — every package `npm ci --omit=dev` installs,
read from `package-lock.json` (entries not flagged `"dev": true`), including
`optionalDependencies`. The dev toolchain is not distributed and is not
listed. Assets that are not code (icons, soundfont, vendored browser
libraries) are covered separately by
[`assets/ASSET-LICENSES.md`](./assets/ASSET-LICENSES.md).
